programmes.t: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programmes.d: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programmes.t: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programmes.d: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

In Arizona, an armored van loaded with cash failed to reach its destination. Authorities suspected an inside job. When the vehicle was recovered with the drivers and the cash missing, those suspicions grew even more.
In Alabama, two desperate criminals fled the custody of a local deputy. Eluding authorities, they made their way across the country in a wave of car theft, abduction, and murder.
Efter næsten at have mistet livet i “Daredevil” er superheltinden ELEKTRA tilbage i en verden af drab og bedrag – stærkere, smukkere og smidigere end før, men...

Jim Andrews tager til byen Big Kill for at slutte sig til sin bror. Undervejs møder han to mænd eftersøgt af den mexicanske hær og hyrer dem til at vejlede og beskytte ham. Når de først er der, står de ansigt til ansigt med en truende prædikant.

programmes.t: Bad Lieutenant: Port of Call - New Orleans
programmes.d: En korrupt betjent i New Orleans efterforsker en række brutale forbrydelser og kæmper samtidig med sin egen spiral af afhængighed og moralsk forfald.

Den tidligere Black Ops-soldat Tom Steele og hans partner Manning får til opgave at overvåge transporten af to mystiske, kvindelige fanger til et gammelt fængsel. Men så eksploderer det hele i et inferno da en elitestyrke af lejesoldater angriber fængslet

In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

When the small community of Noel, Missouri discovered their bank was robbed, they're shocked. When the bank president turned up missing, they're outraged. And when clues began to surface the facts were more terrible than anyone could have guessed.

They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.
A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.
Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

Shirley Russell was determined enough to reach the rank of Captain in the United States Marine Corps. When this officer turned up missing, her colleagues refused to believe she had gone AWOL. It was unclear whether Captain Shirley Russell was alive.

In the 1980's, two partners created a nightclub that would bring them wealth and international fame. The male strip club phenomenon promised female patrons fun and excitement. But the bright lights hid a dark side.
